CommunityApplications.Profile: Always-on Claude Code in a container, reachable from phone or browser via Remote Control. One app: claude-in-container. It runs unprivileged with a single data folder as its only mount, installs its toolchain (git, gh, jq, yq, Terraform, AWS CLI, pnpm, Bruno CLI, Python/uv) at first start from pinned, verified downloads, and keeps your Claude login in that folder. Support and bug reports: GitHub issues.
